compute_engine.description: GCP-Managed MCP server providing tools to list, describe, inspect, and audit Compute Engine VMs and attached disks.

cloud_storage.description: GCP-Managed MCP server providing tools to manage and configure Cloud Storage buckets, lifecycles, and lock policies.

bigquery_billing.description: GCP-Managed MCP server providing tools to query Cloud Billing export datasets and run SQL data queries.

backupdr_mcp.description: Custom Local MCP server providing tools for managing Backup Vaults, executing Backup Plan Associations, and validating compliance.

pricing_mcp.description: Custom Local MCP server providing tools to compute sizing recommendations and estimate Backup & DR licensing and storage costs.

chat_mcp.description: Custom Local MCP server providing tools to format and deliver success notifications and critical failure alerts to team chat channels.
